:::{#def-quadratic-cubic}
#### Quadratic polynomial

A [polynomial](#def-polynomial) of [degree](#def-polynomial-degree) $2$,
$f(x) = a_2 x^2 + a_1 x + a_0$ with $a_2 \ne 0$,
is a **quadratic** polynomial.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-cubic-polynomial}
#### Cubic polynomial

A [polynomial](#def-polynomial) of [degree](#def-polynomial-degree) $3$ is a **cubic** polynomial.

:::
